name: ring leg curl
description: Lying on your back with heels in the rings, you bridge up and curl your feet in. It hits the hamstrings hard.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the ring straps and legs extended.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Bend your knees to pull your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high the whole time.
Extend your legs slowly to return.
